# cgltf

`cgltf.h` (v1.15) and its `LICENSE` from https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf,
release tag `v1.15` (archive SHA-256
`84e352092e5cd6aab7f66de62ddb66beb5e6f18d412ca9d12950d7a55bfef25a`),
unmodified. MIT. Used only by the glTF module (`modules/gltf`), which compiles
